ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_gevonden.des: Deep in old fossil places there are sometimes &6fossils&r: in the chests of the &dFossil Dig&r and the &dfossil mine&r of the Barbecuether, at the &dgiant guh fossil&r, in the &dabandoned guh mine&r and at the &dcave paintings&r under the wool. The dig's daily find is sometimes a fossil too. Find one!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_broedmachine: Make a &6Fossil Hatchery&r. Put a fossil and &616 cheese nibbles&r in and give it &d20 vadskracht&r: under the glass bell the egg turns round.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_uitgebroed.d: After a whole Minecraft day of hatching a baby ancient guh crawls out of the egg. It is yours right away!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_mammoet.desc: Hatch a &6Mammoth Guh&r. In a guh house it does its chores twice as fast, and cuddling gives wool.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_tguh.title: T-Guh
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_tguh.desc: Hatch a &6T-Guh&r. Give it the &dWatch&r chore: it spots monsters coming from very far away.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_pteroguh.des: Hatch a &6Pteroguh&r. When it lives in a guh house it flies the goods to chests far around the house.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fossiel_stokstaartje: Hatch an &6Ancient Meerkat Guh&r. Take it along: it stands up and points out rare guhs nearby.
